root_cause.hygiene_full_fetch: Powerhouse Delivery Hygiene used fetch-depth 0, then fetched origin/main and computed a merge-base locally. In a repository with many stale remote branches this expanded admission latency before useful CI work started.
root_cause.writer_poll: Repository Writer Operational Verification synchronously polled for a generated writer PR up to 72 times with five-second sleeps, occupying a runner for up to six minutes while waiting on external materialization.

prevention.hygiene: Use shallow candidate checkout and GitHub API authority for current main SHA, merge-base, exact PR files and PR patch; never fetch the complete repository history for admission.
prevention.writer: Cap synchronous writer materialization polling at six five-second attempts. If no candidate exists, emit WAITING_EXTERNAL bound to the exact verify SHA and yield for later recovery.

evidence.invariant: Admission and external wait paths must remain bounded without weakening exact-head, branch hygiene, static security or writer lease checks.
